rationale: Four of the five findings are resolved and verified. CR-001 (empty-host collision) and CR-003 (shared-directory test assertion) are fixed and covered by new tests. CR-002 was NOT resolved by the first fix-up: the scoped confirmation pass on the fix-up diff found that CodeMieSSO.getStoredCredentials pre-normalized the URL before calling the store, so legacyKey always equalled key and the migration was dead code in production - the covering tests passed only because they called CredentialStore directly. That is recorded as CR-005, was fixed in-round (847bef23), and its tests now run through CodeMieSSO so they fail without the fix. CR-004 remains unresolved by design: ticket AC5 requires Windows PowerShell verification, which cannot be produced from this machine; the owner has accepted it and will verify before merge. Decision is request-changes solely because CR-004 is unresolved on evidence - per the round contract an unresolved finding blocks, and only the human can close an evidence criterion they have undertaken to satisfy. No third automated review round was run.

findings.title: Legacy-key migration was unreachable from the production read path
findings.problem: CodeMieSSO.getStoredCredentials passed normalizeToBase(url) into retrieveSSOCredentials, so the store received an already-reduced URL and computed legacyKey === key, skipping the migration branch on every real invocation. The two tests certifying CR-002 called CredentialStore directly with a path-bearing URL, the one shape that makes the keys diverge, so they passed against an implementation that did nothing in production.
findings.impact: The orphaned credential blobs that motivated CR-002 would have remained unprobed on read and undeleted on logout, while a green suite asserted the opposite - a false green in exactly the class this review was guarding against.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in 847bef23: pass the caller's URL through unnormalized so the store can derive both keys; normalizeToBase is retained for the global-fallback comparison. Tests repointed at CodeMieSSO so they fail without the fix (verified RED then GREEN).
findings.evidence: src/providers/plugins/sso/sso.auth.ts:184 before the fix; tests/integration/sso-credential-key-normalization.test.ts legacy-key block; RED run showed 'reads a credential stored under the legacy key' failing via the production path while the delete test passed, because clearStoredCredentials never pre-normalized.
